name: fise
description: Fast Interoperable Structured Envelope (FISE) - generated, profile-governed application representations for structured and binary data.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/mark-cli-executable.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/v2/*.test.mjs && npm run test:python
scripts.verify:types: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2020 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --lib ES2020,DOM --types node --skipLibCheck tests/v2/public-api.ts
scripts.verify:benchmarks: npm run build && tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2020 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --lib ES2020,DOM --types node --skipLibCheck benchmarks/*.ts
scripts.verify:package: npm run build && npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:types && node scripts/verify-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-python-package.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run verify:examples && npm run verify:package && npm run verify:benchmarks && npm run verify:packed && npm run verify:browser

author: An Nguyen
